dispositions.title: Restore step leaves the patched image in the shared model
facts: The owner publishes the edited next version into m.imageLayer.Image. The later restore transaction rebinds that retained edited 4096-square image after the temporary 2x1 halo texture.
Restoration refers to placement/filter/mesh bindings and texture dimensions. No stats, report or contract claims pristine pixels.
Downstream budget/rebuild/resize checks retain the edited source without assuming original pixel colors. Removal then clears Image and checks transparent empty pixels.
The private smoke has one caller in one smoke run with a fresh model, closes the independent original-image window and calls Application.Close afterward. No persisted model/user document survives.
Resetting the source to original would discard the edited version intentionally retained through GPU recreation.

discarded_by_prism.disposition: Prism confirmation refuted: expected injected budget error is identified by report/JSON.
discarded_by_prism.counter_reconciliation: Main canvas cumulative 3074 image tile writes = 1024 initial + 1 changed tile + 1 small halo tile + 1024 return-to-4K + 1024 explicit rebuild. Bytes = 3*67108864 + 65536 + 8 = 201392136. Independent window counters are separate.

final_internal_result: Pass: no remaining actionable production defect. Four internal source/assertion findings resolved before Prism. Single Prism finding independently refuted. No repeated unchanged Prism review.
